seed_fact: Confusing pricing pages with hidden fees destroy trust. Be transparent or remove pricing entirely.
caption:
Ever wonder why prospects leave your site before buying? If your pricing page hides extra costs or feels confusing, visitors lose trust and walk away. Keep prices clear or use a simple ‘Contact for pricing’ note. DM me for a quick website trust check.
